Making Breakthroughs Happen

Breakthroughs are more than milestones—they’re moments when hope turns into reality. For decades, Biogen has created medicines for hard-to-treat diseases. Scientific curiosity and aspirations to help people around the world are at the core of our legacy and our vision for the future.

Driving an Innovative Pipeline

We’re using cutting-edge science to develop potential breakthrough therapies in neurology, immunology, and rare diseases.

Careers

Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

We came to Biogen to make an impact, to transform rigorous science into first-in-class medicines. We stay to create new possibilities together. We strive for excellence and go beyond the expected because we care deeply about making a difference for the many people we serve. Our dedication to our work is not just about professional achievement; it is about the profound impact that our work can have.
